hooks.command:
OUT=$(git pull --ff-only 2>&1); STATUS=$?; if [ $STATUS -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Not possible to fast-forward'; then printf '[Automated SessionStart hook output, not from the user] git pull --ff-only failed at session start: local and remote history have diverged (likely unpushed local commits alongside new remote commits). Working tree was left untouched - nothing merged, nothing conflicted. Mention this to the user early in your reply; do not merge, sync, commit, or push on your own without them asking.
'; else printf '[Automated SessionStart hook output, not from the user] git pull --ff-only failed at session start (not a divergence issue): %s
Working tree left untouched. Likely a connectivity or auth issue - mention it to the user if relevant.
' "$OUT"; fi
